arg.name: prefix
arg.description: Prefix of the joint names, useful for multi-robot setup. If changed, joint names in controller config must also be updated.

arg.name: robot_model
arg.description: The Kassow robot model to use.

arg.name: description_package
arg.description: Description package with robot URDF/xacro files. Usually not set, it enables use of a custom description.

arg.name: description_file
arg.description: URDF/XACRO description file with the robot.

let.name: robot_description
let.value: $(command '$(find-exec xacro) $(find-pkg-share $(var description_package))/urdf/$(var description_file).urdf.xacro \ ros2_control_hardware_type:=$(var ros2_control_hardware_type) \ is_async:=$(var is_async) \ scheduling_policy:=$(var scheduling_policy) \ thread_priority:=$(var thread_priority) \ cpu_affinity:=$(var cpu_affinity) \ robot_model:=$(var robot_model) \ prefix:=$(var prefix) \ ip_address:=$(var ip_address) \ port:=$(var port) \ session_id:=$(var session_id)')
